body:
Milestone 9 (`project-pages`): two more project pages get a figure from the project's own output.

- `selfrep-repair`: working fleet vs repair cost share, discrete-event median with 5th-95th percentile band against the closed-form vitamin balance (section A of `results.txt`).
- `selfrep-alufreq`: highest reachable first-mode frequency vs carriage mass for steel, aluminium and hardwood.

Each `experiments/figure.py` parses the committed `results.txt` (no retyped numbers, standard library only); no new results. READMEs list the command. Rendered both SVGs in Chromium to check them. `python site/build.py` prints `ok` (400 projects). Run record appended.
